evaluations.candidateRepresentation: normalized finite-difference polynomial or bounded recurrence with declared order and assumptions
evaluations.certificateRoute: domain-specific finite-data witness plus optional solver obligation for the recurrence relation

independentEvaluator.method: evaluate the frozen recurrence on held-out terms and verify finite-difference or recurrence consistency over the declared finite domain
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: does not prove uniqueness of an infinite sequence or external novelty

evaluations.multipleSolutionPolicy: retain all valid hypotheses and score coverage, simplicity, and ambiguity separately
evaluations.nullResultPolicy: retain no-fit, multiple-fit, unsupported-order, timeout, and failed-holdout outcomes
evaluations.pilotRequirement: characterize ambiguous finite prefixes and ensure no unique-infinite-sequence claim is emitted

evaluations.candidateRepresentation: directed AST pattern pair plus normalized assumption predicates
evaluations.certificateRoute: solver-neutral obligation with denominator assumptions and retained symbolic result

independentEvaluator.method: cross-multiply under declared nonzero denominators, compare exact polynomial normal forms, and search bounded rational counterexamples
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: transcendental functions, undeclared branch cuts, or assumptions not expressible in the normalized predicate language

evaluations.multipleSolutionPolicy: credit every distinct valid normalized rule; do not require equality with a hidden reference
evaluations.nullResultPolicy: retain zero-output, refuted, unsupported, timeout, and incomplete-assumption outcomes
evaluations.pilotRequirement: verify denominator-assumption propagation and false-positive rejection on development-only examples
evaluations.splitUnit: denominator-factor topology and normalized placeholder-incidence signature

evaluations.candidateRepresentation: versioned macro operator with ordered primitive steps, applicability guards, and assumptions
evaluations.certificateRoute: replayable derivation trace plus paired utility and regression report

independentEvaluator.method: verify every primitive step and compare baseline versus macro-enabled search under identical held-out inputs, targets, inventory, strategy, and budgets
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: utility is not truth, novelty, or mathematical importance

evaluations.multipleSolutionPolicy: compare every valid macro independently; equivalent step sequences share one normalized identity
evaluations.nullResultPolicy: retain no-macro, no-gain, trade-off, regression, timeout, and unsupported-task outcomes
evaluations.pilotRequirement: measure candidate volume and duplicate collapse while preserving exact primitive-step provenance
evaluations.splitUnit: transformation motif, source family, and macro-structure signature

evaluations.candidateRepresentation: directed relation pattern, comparison-direction effect, and normalized sign assumptions
evaluations.certificateRoute: solver-neutral inequality obligation with assumption and translation evidence

independentEvaluator.method: translate supported polynomial inequalities and assumptions to the solver-neutral IR, request refutation or confirmation, and search bounded rational counterexamples
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: non-polynomial ordering, incomplete sign assumptions, and translation loss

evaluations.multipleSolutionPolicy: credit distinct valid transformations with non-equivalent assumption sets separately
evaluations.nullResultPolicy: retain unknown, unsupported, missing-assumption, refuted, and timeout outcomes
evaluations.pilotRequirement: build a domain adapter and demonstrate that missing or weakened sign assumptions fail closed
evaluations.splitUnit: comparison-direction transition, sign-context topology, and polynomial structure signature

evaluations.candidateRepresentation: canonical finite object plus constructive operation lineage
evaluations.certificateRoute: canonical object, constraint-check receipt, objective score, and optional exhaustive optimality certificate at small size

independentEvaluator.method: check every constraint exactly and compute the declared objective; exhaustively verify selected small sizes where feasible
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: scales only to preregistered finite sizes and does not prove asymptotic optimality

evaluations.multipleSolutionPolicy: retain all non-isomorphic valid constructions at each objective score
evaluations.nullResultPolicy: retain invalid, duplicate, no-improvement, timeout, and incomplete-exhaustion outcomes
evaluations.pilotRequirement: add a generic finite-construction domain, isomorphism-aware identity, and bounded exact evaluator
evaluations.splitUnit: object size, constraint topology, and construction-operator signature
